message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: employer Chen delayed wages, owes 85,361 RMB to 15 workers, refused to pay, escaped, later partially paid 51,000 RMB, remaining debt with IOU. This likely constitutes "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" (failure to pay labor remuneration) under Article 276 of Criminal Law. Also possibly "非法占有他人财物罪"? But the specific crime is "拒不支付劳动报酬罪". Also could be "逃避债务罪"? Not typical. The law: Article 276: "用人单位克扣或者不支付劳动者的劳动报酬，数额较大，情节严重的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处或者单处罚金；数额特别巨大或者情节特别严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So yes.

Thus answer: single crime. Format: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬罪<eoa>
